Author: aurelius
Name: Azeron HUD
Description:
Draws your Azeron keypad in the same layout as the Azeron configurator, overlaid on the game. Each button is labelled with what it does right now: the hotbar action's icon and name when the key is bound to a hotbar slot, the FFXIV keybind's name when it isn't, and the raw key or your own Azeron label otherwise. Actions on cooldown or unusable are dimmed, like a miniature hotbar.

Reads your Azeron profile straight from the Azeron Software config directory, so labels follow whatever you've set up there. Hidden by default; toggle with /azeronhud.

Supports the Azeron Cyborg II.
Punchline: Your Azeron keypad, drawn on screen with what each button actually does.
